  • Estruturar, documentar e aprimorar políticas, fluxos, procedimentos, critérios de priorização, níveis de alçada e controles internos;
  • Assegurar a rastreabilidade das ações de cobrança e a adequada formalização de contatos, propostas, acordos, pagamentos, garantias e demais evidências;
  • Garantir, em parceria com o Jurídico, que os casos encaminhados à judicialização estejam completos, fundamentados e documentalmente preparados, preservando a exigibilidade do crédito;
  • Liderar, desenvolver e dimensionar a equipe de acordo com o volume, a complexidade e as prioridades das carteiras, atuando também como referência técnica em casos críticos;
  • Definir e acompanhar indicadores de recuperação, produtividade, aging, acordos, promessas de pagamento, SLAs, custos e qualidade operacional;
  • Conduzir comitês de cobrança e elaborar análises executivas sobre resultados, riscos, estratégias adotadas e oportunidades de recuperação;
  • Identificar oportunidades de automação e ganho de escala, traduzindo necessidades operacionais em requisitos para Produto, Engenharia e fornecedores de tecnologia;
  • Aplicar dados e inteligência artificial na segmentação de carteiras, priorização de casos, recomendação de estratégias e controle da qualidade operacional;
  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com clientes, fundos, cedentes, escritórios jurídicos e parceiros especializados, assegurando alinhamento sobre estratégias, prazos e resultados.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência consolidada em liderança de operações de cobrança extrajudicial e recuperação de crédito;
  • Vivência na gestão de carteiras inadimplentes de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado dos fluxos de cobrança, negociação, protesto, negativação, acordos, garantias e preparação para judicialização;
  • Experiência na estruturação, revisão e melhoria de processos operacionais;
  • Histórico de liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes de alta performance;
  • Experiência com indicadores, metas, SLAs e gestão orientada por dados;
  • Capacidade de análise de carteiras, definição de prioridades e construção de estratégias de recuperação;
  • Experiência em projetos de automação, implantação de sistemas ou transformação digital;
  • Boa interlocução com áreas Jurídica, Financeira, Produto e Engenharia;
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma estratégica e, simultaneamente, acompanhar a execução operacional em profundidade.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência em operações de crédito, cobrança ou recuperação de ativos no agronegócio;
  • Vivência em fintechs, securitizadoras, FIDCs, FIAGROs, instituições financeiras, empresas de insumos ou gestoras de crédito;
  • Conhecimento sobre operações estruturadas, direitos creditórios, cessão de crédito e garantias agrícolas;
  • Familiaridade com CPRs, duplicatas, penhor, alienação fiduciária, cessão fiduciária, garantias reais e pessoais;
  • Experiência na gestão de escritórios jurídicos, consultorias e fornecedores especializados;
  • Conhecimento em inteligência artificial, automação e análise de dados aplicadas à cobrança;
  • Vivência com LegalOps, sistemas de cobrança, CRMs ou plataformas de gestão de carteiras;
  • Pós-graduação em Finanças, Gestão, Agronegócio, Direito Empresarial ou áreas correlatas.


Competências Esperadas

  • Liderança com forte orientação para execução;
  • Visão estratégica e pensamento sistêmico;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões em ambientes de pressão e incerteza;
  • Profundidade analítica e domínio de indicadores;
  • Excelente capacidade de negociação;
  • Comunicação clara, firme e executiva;
  • Disciplina de processos e atenção à qualidade;
  • Senso de urgência e capacidade de priorização;
  • Protagonismo, autonomia e responsabilidade;
  • Capacidade de construir soluções em ambientes em desenvolvimento;
  • Facilidade para transitar entre negócio, jurídico, operação e tecnologia;
  • Orientação para resultado sem comprometer governança e segurança jurídica.


Principais Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Aumento da taxa e do valor de recuperação das carteiras;
  • Redução do tempo médio de tratamento e recuperação;
  • Aumento da conversão de acordos e promessas de pagamento;
  • Cumprimento dos SLAs operacionais;
  • Redução de falhas documentais e operacionais;
  • Qualidade e completude dos casos encaminhados à judicialização;
  • Evolução da produtividade e da capacidade operacional;
  • Maior previsibilidade sobre resultados, riscos e expectativa de recuperação;
  • Implantação de automações e ganhos mensuráveis de eficiência;
  • Satisfação dos clientes e stakeholders com a gestão das carteiras.


O que temos por aqui:

  • Trabalho remoto (encontros ocasionais na sede em São José dos Campos/SP)
  • Remuneração compatível (PJ)
  • Benefício flexível via cartão Swile
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)
  • Convênio médico Porto Saúde
  • Convênio odontológico Uniodonto

title: Consultor de Investimentos - WS - Parceiros XP
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Certificação CEA, CFP, CFA, C-PRO R, C-PRO I, CPA-20 e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades

title: Member of the Board of Advisors
description:
About the Company


Founded in 1950, Westfield FC has been an important part of its local football community for more than 75 years. Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.


Company Website:


About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors


Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.


We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.


Key Responsibilities


  • Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network.
  • Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships.
  • Provide strategic guidance on club growth, marketing, fundraising, commercial partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Support revenue-generating and brand-building initiatives when appropriate.
  • Participate in periodic advisory meetings and provide feedback on key priorities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Passion for football and the business of sports.
  • Experience as an executive, entrepreneur, investor, advisor, or business leader.
  • Strong professional network that can support club growth.
  • Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.


Compensation & Benefits


This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.


Why Join Us


Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.


Equal Opportunity Statement


Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


Selection decisions are based on qualifications, merit, business needs, and the ability to contribute to the responsibilities of the advisory role.

title: Recruiter
description:
Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


(POSITION TO AT LEAST 2 YEAR EXPERIENCED RECRUITER)


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.

This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer


  • Compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote, working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities


  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs
  • Source, screen, and interview candidates for the U.S. market
  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms
  • Manage and maintain healthy candidate pipelines
  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience end-to-end
  • Maintain consistent communication with hiring managers and candidates
  • Support strategic hiring initiatives for clients and internal teams


What We’re Looking For


  • 2+ year of experience with Recruitment/Hunting in the American market
  • Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment
  • Strong English communication skills (professional level)
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple requisitions
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have


  • Background in corporate or executive recruitment
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-paced hiring environments
  • Experience working with global stakeholders
  • Experience recruiting for international or U.S. clients is a strong plus



Technical Requirements


  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Regional Business Leader ( US & Canada)
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a highly execution- Regional Business Leader to lead E-MAGE ’s market entry and project delivery in the United States/ Canada.

This role is best suited for a Program Director / Senior Project Director from an EPC background, who can manage multiple projects, build teams .


Key Responsibilities

1. Program & Project Delivery (Core)

  • Lead multiple transmission line projects (EPC or EPC-like) across the US
  • Take full responsibility for schedule, cost, quality, and HSE performance
  • Build and implement a program-level project management system

2. Client & Market Engagement

  • Support key client relationships (TSOs, IOUs, large energy users)
  • Contribute to project acquisition through technical and delivery credibility
  • Translate client needs into actionable project execution plans

3. Team Building & Leadership

  • Build and lead the US project delivery and engineering team
  • Drive collaboration between local teams and global HQ (design & technology)
  • Develop a high-performance, execution-focused culture

4. Execution & Delivery Excellence

  • Ensure successful delivery of lighthouse projects in the US market
  • Drive continuous improvement in project execution processes
  • Deliver projects on time, within budget, and to high quality standards


Qualifications

  • Proven experience in EPC companies (power transmission preferred)
  • Background as Program Director / Project Director / Senior PM managing multiple projects
  • Strong track record of end-to-end project delivery
  • Experience working with US utilities (TSO / IOU) is highly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to build teams and drive execution
  • Strong communication skills with client-facing capability

Responsável pelo planejamento, organização, gerenciamento e controle de um Centro de Distribuição, envolvendo as áreas Comercial, Logística, Operações e Administrativa, atuando na orientação e acompanhamento de suas atividades e desempenho, garantindo o atingimento das metas estabelecidas, bem como contribuir para o aumento da participação da empresa no mercado, dentro dos prazos, legislação vigente, padrões de, através de adequada alocação de seus recursos humanos, técnicos e materiais.


Vaga de banco de currículos!


Principais Desafios


  • Assegurar a execução da estratégia comercial definida, garantindo a rentabilidade das operações comerciais, o desenvolvimento da área comercial e a ampliação do volume de negócios
  • Garantir em conjunto com a liderança logística e de transporte da unidade, as operações de Distribuição, mantendo o padrão de qualidade de armazenagem e de movimentação dos produtos, bem como a qualidade da entrega dos mesmos em todos os pontos de vendas
  • Garantir a exatidão dos estoques, produto acabado e ativo de giro sob sua responsabilidade, mediante execução das rotinas e monitoramento periódico dos inventários
  • Elaborar o orçamento anual das despesas do Centro de Distribuição, através de análise de históricos e previsões de crescimento, buscando atingir as metas traçadas para atingimento do lucro líquido e o aumento do market share, visando seu cumprimento em conformidade com as diretrizes estabelecidas pela empresa
  • Garantir a conferência dos caixas do CD bem como conferir o montante de valores enviados para área de controle assegurando a acuracidade financeira
  • Conduzir a gestão de pessoas mantendo a equipe capacitada, habilitada e motivada para realização dos trabalhos


Requisitos para o cargo:


  • Forte experiência em Gestão de Equipes de Vendas, Gestão Orçamentária, Administrativa e conhecimentos de rotinas Operações;
  • Para essa vaga é indispensável habilidade com negociações comerciais;
  • Ensino Superior Completo (desejável pós-graduação)
  • CNH B ativa;

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: Bilingual English Teacher - Remote Role [T]
description:
Role Overview

We are currently inviting qualified ESL teachers to apply for a remote instructional role supporting international learners through our structured online teaching platform.


This is a contract-based teaching position offering self-managed scheduling within a professional global education environment.


Why Join Us

  • Remote teaching structure
  • Self-managed scheduling
  • Access to professional development opportunities
  • Supportive global educator network
  • Dedicated online teaching portal


Core Requirements

·      Bachelor’s Degree or higher

·      Recognized English teaching certification (TESOL / TEFL / TESL – CELTA or equivalent preferred)

·      Minimum of 2 years ESL teaching experience

·      Demonstrated commitment to professional growth and teaching excellence


Professional Qualifications (Preferred)

·      Advanced ESL qualifications (Level 5 equivalent or higher such as CELTA, TKT, DipTESOL, PGCE, MEd, PhDEd)

·      Continuous professional development (CPD) participation

·      Experience with international learners


Language Capability Requirements

·      English proficiency at CEFR C2 (or equivalent) is required

·      Proficiency in at least one additional language at CEFR B1+ or higher is strongly preferred


﻿Teaching Scope

You may support either young learners or adult learners depending on teaching allocation.


Students may include:

  • School-aged learners
  • University students
  • Working professionals
  • Adult learners seeking conversational fluency


All curriculum materials are provided and accessible in advance of teaching sessions.


Next Step

  • Qualified candidates are invited to submit their resume for review.

title: Declaration Drafter (Portuguese/English) - Humanitarian Immigration
description:
Who Are We?


Bueno Law is a trailblazing immigration law firm focused on empowering the Latin American LGBTQ+ community, survivors of domestic violence, victims of human trafficking, and other vulnerable individuals. We provide life-changing legal services to immigrants in the United States, and we’re looking for passionate, people-first individuals to join our remote team.


We specialize in:


  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.


Your Role as a Declaration Drafter


We are looking for an immigration declaration drafter to join our team of Warriors. We do not require experience; we offer a full training program. The ideal candidate is 100% fluent in English and Portuguese, has excellent writing and communication skills, is detail-oriented and a self-starter. Experience in the Psychological or Social Services field. Must be able to work well with different cultures and languages. We require a positive attitude and someone who strives for finding solutions instead of obstacles.


We would like the new Warrior to be able to commit full-time to this position (9am-6pm PST).


Who we are looking for:


  • Experience in providing psychological or social services
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Portuguese
  • Ability to Multi-Task
  • Strong Analytical Skills
  • Decision-Making ability
  • Strong Research Skills
  • Team Player
  • Excellent Customer Service Skills
  • Highly organized individual
  • Fast learner
  • Honest
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Must match our growth and improvement mindset and help implement efficiency techniques
  • Reliable and dependable
  • Hardworking


Essential Duties And Responsibilities:


  • Drafting client declarations.
  • Schedule appointments and maintain calendars.
  • Write and edit documents from letters to reports and instructional documents.
  • Create and maintain filing systems, both electronic and physical.
  • Handle daily client communications.
  • Maintains filing systems as assigned.
  • Retrieves information as requested from records, email, minutes, and other related documents; prepares written summaries of data when needed.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.


What We Offer:


  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Senior Product Designer — Payments & Billing
description:
This role is open to candidates based in Brazil only.


About SigmaMD


SigmaMD is changing the way people manage their health. We build the platform where modern clinics run their entire business on — clinician apps, patient apps, and the admin tooling behind them — covering charting, a number of embedded AI tools, e-prescribing, labs, scheduling, patient messaging, and the money.


About this role


We're looking for a senior product designer who wants more than screens. You'll own the design of our most demanding domain end to end — the research, the flows, the interface, and a real share of the product thinking behind it.


Your primary surface is Payments & Billing. Today our practices bill patients and employers directly: memberships and plan cycles, employer contracts with coverage rules, eligibility roster feeds, proration, invoices and charge items, refunds and reissues, superbills, and card/ACH processing through our merchant partner.


This is not a domain you can design from a wireframe kit. When a patient joins on the 14th, when an employer covers 60% up to a cap, when a membership pauses mid-cycle and is reinstated — someone has to understand exactly what the numbers do, then design an interface that makes it obvious to a physician who is not an accountant. That person is you.


And the next chapter is big. We're expanding into full insurance billing — claims submission, eligibility verification, remittance posting, denials workflow, and prior authorization via a clearinghouse partnership — so hybrid practices can run membership revenue and insurance revenue side by side. Designing it is the most interesting problem we can offer.


You won't only touch billing. Money and care delivery are inseparable here: a charge item comes from an order, a superbill comes out of a signed note, eligibility gets checked at booking. Expect to design across the EHR itself wherever it meets the money. Fellow product designers, engineers, QA, and our customer success team are all people you'll collaborate with daily. Nobody reports to you, but we expect seniority to show up as more than shipping: reviewing work, sharing the reasoning behind your decisions, and helping the designers around you grow is part of how this role operates day to day. You get real ownership of your surfaces, and a company small enough that you can take any question straight to the person who can answer it.


What you'll do


Design it.

  • Own the full design arc for Payments & Billing: research, information architecture, flows, prototypes, and production-ready screens in Figma.
  • Make dense, numbers-heavy interfaces feel calm and obvious. A physician should never have to think about how billing works.
  • Extend our design system where the domain demands patterns we don't have yet.


Own the product thinking.

  • Shape the roadmap for your area alongside our team and customers.
  • Write the stories engineering builds from — which field, which state transition, what happens at the boundary, what the money does. Our specs are precise, and designers write them here.
  • Help define our move into insurance billing.


Talk to customers — and onboard them yourself.

  • Be on calls and in writing with US physicians and practice administrators, and personally onboard new practices. Sitting with a physician while they configure their billing is the best research you'll ever run.
  • Turn messy operational complaints into design decisions. Most of our best work starts as a frustrated support thread.


Do the math.

  • Model pricing and fee scenarios, reason about proration and cycle boundaries, and stress-test flows against edge cases before they reach a spec. Ambiguity in a billing interface becomes a real charge on someone's bank account.


Make the design team better.

  • Review other designers' work, explain the why behind your decisions, and share what you know. Some of that is people, and some of it is what the team builds on: the design system, the patterns, the way decisions get documented.


What we're looking for


1. Exceptional written and spoken English — our single most important requirement. You'll be on live calls with US clinicians, writing specs engineers build from, and writing directly to customers. We assess this seriously and early.


2. Startup experience in a design or product role. You've worked somewhere small enough that you owned outcomes, not tickets — where the answer to \"who decides this?\" was you. Senior Product Designer, Product Manager, Product Owner, or founder all count.


3. A technical background. You don't need to ship production code, but you should read an API contract comfortably, reason about a data model, and hold your own in a technical discussion without deferring. Front-end experience or a CS/Engineering background is a strong plus.


4. Genuinely comfortable with numbers. You'll design around money. You should enjoy — not tolerate — building the spreadsheet, deriving the proration formula, and stress-testing a pricing model against edge cases.


Plus: 5+ years in product design with real ownership of a domain; a portfolio of complex, information-dense product work (not marketing pages); expert Figma; and writing precise enough that a developer never has to guess.


Who you might be


You're a designer who got restless about why you were designing it, and started owning the product decision itself. Maybe you effectively ran the roadmap for your area at a SaaS company. Maybe you co-founded something small and had to be the designer, the front-end developer, and the person who understood the unit economics all at once. What matters is that you've held both halves at once, been close enough to the code to be dangerous, and had to defend a number to someone who cared about it.


Nice to have

title: Video Creator
description:
Job Title: Video Creator / Creative Editor

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Compensation: Retainer that reflects experience, seniority and skill level, + bonuses.

Required Assessment:

Submission Form:

───────────────────────────────

916 Studios is a premium creative production company producing social-first content for brands, creators, agencies, and public companies. Our clients range from fast-scaling consumer brands to publicly listed companies, with projects including work for Google, Oracle and TikTok.

───────────────────────────────

THE ROLE:

We're looking for a multi-disciplinary Video Creator / Creative Editor who doesn’t wait to be told that something ‘could be better’. Video Creators produce high-performance content for social media, website and beyond, blending strategy, editing, motion, sound, and narrative into media that drives results, (not just views).

───────────────────────────────

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Edit premium short & long-form content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X
  • Own projects end-to-end, from brief to final delivery
  • Act as your own creative director, i.e. source, create, or generate every asset if needed, including: graphics, motion, sound, etc, to cohesively serve the story
  • Build engaging hooks, retention and pacing
  • Adapt creative styles intelligently to different brands and audiences
  • Deliver strong first drafts

───────────────────────────────

COMPLETE THE ASSESSMENT AND APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

  • 5+ years of professional editing experience
  • A portfolio of social-first content that proves viewer-retention with links to work currently live on social media
  • Advanced Premiere Pro + working After Effects so that you can build from scratch, (not reliant on templates)
  • A strong sense of storytelling, with the ability to independently select and organise footage into a coherent, engaging narrative even without a provided script
  • The ability to work efficiently under pressure and at speed without compromising quality
  • Strong sense for design, photo editing, and branding
  • A strong sound design, colour grading, and audio mixing ability
  • A deep understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and platform-native editing
  • Clean workflow habits: methodical, organised, no missed deadlines and excellent communication.

───────────────────────────────

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

  • You consistently deliver high-quality edits with meticulous attention to detail
  • Your first cuts are robust and require minimal revision (if any!)
  • You actively look for ways to improve content without being asked
  • You anticipate roadblocks and resolve issues independently before escalating
  • You meet deadlines consistently and flag potential delays early
  • You bring fresh ideas, formats, and techniques to every project

───────────────────────────────

WHY JOIN US:

  • 100% remote, flexible working
  • Full creative ownership from day one without micromanagement
  • International brands and creator campaigns
  • Performance bonuses + genuine path to a core creative role
  • Up-skilling with AI workflows and content systems

───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY:

  • Complete the required creative assessment first:
  • Submit your assessment via this form:
  • IMPORTANT: Applications without a completed assessment will not be considered.

title: Project Manager - Civil Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager – Marine Works who is willing to relocate to Africa to lead and oversee consultancy and site supervision activities for port and marine infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will manage project execution from planning through construction supervision, ensuring delivery within scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards.

This role requires strong technical expertise in port infrastructure, stakeholder coordination, contractor management, and on-site supervision experience.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate port and marine infrastructure projects.
  • Supervise consultancy and site supervision teams during project execution.
  • Monitor construction progress, quality, HSE compliance, and contract performance.
  • Review technical submissions, drawings, method statements, and project documentation.
  • Coordinate with clients, contractors, consultants, and regulatory authorities.
  • Ensure compliance with project specifications, standards, and timelines.
  • Prepare project reports, progress updates, and risk assessments.
  • Support procurement, budgeting, scheduling, and contract administration activities.
  • Lead site meetings and resolve technical and operational issues.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, or related field.
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in port, marine, or infrastructure projects.
  • Proven experience in consultancy and construction/site supervision roles.
  • Strong knowledge of port infrastructure, dredging, quay walls, terminals, and marine works.
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication and reporting skills.
  • Fluent in English
  • Proficiency in project management tools and MS Office.
  • PMP certification or equivalent is an advantage.

Preferred Skills

title: Oportunidades de Estágio em Engenharia - Lajeado/RS
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O estágio é voltado para estudantes que desejam aprender na prática, se desenvolver profissionalmente e construir carreira em um ambiente colaborativo, inovador e com propósito.


Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em áreas estratégicas do negócio, contribuindo para projetos que impactam diretamente a vida das pessoas e o futuro do saneamento no Brasil.


Conheça algumas das áreas:


ENGENHARIAS

As áreas de engenharia atuam diretamente na operação, expansão e melhoria contínua dos serviços de saneamento, garantindo eficiência, inovação e impacto positivo para a população.

Como estagiário(a), você poderá atuar em:

  • Engenharia Civil;
  • Engenharia Ambiental e Sanitária;


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Estar regularmente matriculado em curso de graduação, formação prevista a partir de dezembro de 2027;
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza e objetividade;
  • Organização, responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Perfil analítico, com interesse em processos e melhoria contínua;
  • Proatividade, colaboração e vontade de aprender;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint e Word);
  • Residir em Lajeado/RS ou regiões próximas.


Informações adicionais


  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Gympass;
  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Kit office.

title: DGB Americas Training Manager South Latam
description:
DGB Americas Training Manager – South LATAM

DOLCE & GABBANA Beauty

Location : Brazil

Reporting to: Education Senior Manager


Role Mission

We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Training Manager to lead all education initiatives across South LATAM. This individual will be responsible for elevating brand knowledge, retail excellence, and client experience across Fragrance, Makeup, and Skincare categories

The role acts as the regional guardian of training excellence, ensuring that all distributor and travel retail markets are aligned with global brand standards while adapting programs to local needs. This person will not only execute training programs but also build long-term capabilities within distributor teams, driving sell-out performance and brand desirability in the region.


Key Responsibilities

1. Regional Training Strategy & Execution

  • Own and execute the education strategy across South LATAM distributors and TR markets for fragrance, makeup, and skincare categories.
  • Adapt global training materials into impactful, locally relevant training modules (in-person and digital).
  • Develop and manage the regional training calendar, ensuring alignment with product launches and commercial priorities.
  • Deliver high-quality training across key markets, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution.
  • Manage the training budget for the region, ensuring efficient allocation of resources aligned with business priorities.
  • Partner and maintain close communication with Fashion boutique teams to execute training initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand standards and elevating client experience.


2. Distributor Partnership & Capability Building

  • Act as the main education liaison for distributors across South LATAM.
  • Train and coach local trainers and retail teams to ensure scalable knowledge transfer.
  • Track training effectiveness through KPIs (sell-out, engagement, certification rates) and implement improvements.
  • Tailor training approaches based on market maturity, cultural nuances, and business needs.


3. Brand & Product Expertise

  • Serve as the regional expert across fragrance, makeup, and skincare, ensuring deep product and brand storytelling knowledge.
  • Lead all training-related aspects of product launches, ensuring teams are fully prepared prior to market activation.
  • Elevate in-store execution standards through coaching on client experience, selling techniques, and service rituals.


4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to align training initiatives with business objectives and sell-out targets.
  • Collaborate with Communications, Digital, and Trade Marketing teams to ensure a consistent brand message across all touchpoints.
  • Maintain alignment with brand DNA and guidelines.


5. Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive adoption of digital learning platforms and hybrid training formats (virtual, e-learning, etc.).
  • Identify and share best-in-class training practices across markets to elevate regional performance.
  • Gather feedback from the field to continuously refine training content and approach.


Requirements & Skills

  • 5+ years in Training/Education within the beauty industry (fragrance, makeup, and skincare preferred).
  • Strong understanding of LATAM markets
  • Proven ability to design and deliver engaging training programs to diverse audiences.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence different stakeholders.
  • Solid understanding of retail environments, client experience, and sales drivers.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese .
  • Willingness to travel frequently across South LATAM

title: Senior Generative AI Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga


Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Engenheira de IA Generativa para atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções inteligentes baseadas em Large Language Models (LLMs), agentes autônomos de IA e arquiteturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).

Esta pessoa será responsável por conceber, desenvolver e operacionalizar aplicações de IA em ambiente produtivo, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, governança e alta performance. Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Integrar LLMs a sistemas internos, APIs e plataformas corporativas.
  • Otimizar fluxos de inferência visando performance, escalabilidade e confiabilidade.
  • Implementar práticas de segurança, governança e qualidade para soluções de IA.

  • Monitorar aplicações, realizar troubleshooting e promover melhorias contínuas.

  • Documentar soluções técnicas, processos e padrões de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios

  • Experiência com IA Generativa, LLMs e desenvolvimento de Agentes de IA.
  • Experiência na construção de arquiteturas RAG.
  • Domínio da linguagem Python.
  • Experiência com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex ou similares.
  • Conhecimento em bancos vetoriais e técnicas de embeddings, chunking e busca semântica.
  • Experiência com APIs REST, Git e Docker.
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud Platform).
  • Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD e deploy de aplicações em produção.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança, governança e compliance para soluções de IA.
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de software, microsserviços e integração de sistemas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock ou Vertex AI.
  • Conhecimento em LLMOps, MLOps e observabilidade.
  • Familiaridade com Kubernetes.
  • Experiência com GraphRAG, MCP (Model Context Protocol) e arquiteturas multiagentes.
  • Conhecimento em bancos vetoriais como Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus ou Qdrant.
  • Experiência com monitoramento de aplicações de IA em produção.

description:
Instrutor(a) de Inglês – Aulas Online (Autônomo)

Estamos em busca de instrutores de inglês fluentes para ministrar aulas online. Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais autônomos que desejam atuar de forma remota, com flexibilidade de horários e possibilidade de ganhos conforme a disponibilidade de aulas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Ministrar aulas de inglês a alunos de diferentes níveis, de forma remota.
  • Cumprir a programação de aulas conforme combinado.
  • Elaborar relatórios mensais de aulas dadas para fins de pagamento.

Link de inscrição em nossa plataforma:

  • Fluência no idioma inglês (oral e escrito).
  • Maior de 18 anos.
  • Computador com boa conexão de internet.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar de segunda a quinta-feira.
  • Espaço adequado para ministrar aulas online.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia como professor(a) ou instrutor(a) de inglês.
  • Disponibilidade no período noturno.

  • Prestador(a) de serviços (autônomo ou MEI).

Remuneração:

  • Pagamento por aula. A remuneração mensal pode variar conforme a carga horária assumida, podendo atingir uma média de R$2.200,00.

Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto / Home office.

Tipo de vaga: Autônomo

Pergunta(s) de seleção:

  • Você tem computador (ou laptop) e uma boa conexão de internet?

Idioma:

  • Inglês (Preferencial)
  • Localização do trabalho: Remoto

title: Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote
description:
What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide


Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.


What you will do


  • Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
  • Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
  • Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
  • Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
  • Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
  • Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed


What you will bring to the role


  • Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
  • Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
  • Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities


Your experience


  • Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
  • Bachelor’s degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
  • Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
  • Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Senior Business Analyst – Salesforce / CRM
description:
Senior Business Analyst (Salesforce/CRM)


Location: Brazil - Remote

Employment type: Full-time CLT

Compensation: Total monthly package of up to BRL 9,600, including benefits

English level: Advanced


About Us

LATAM Digital Hub by Stefanini connects highly skilled technology professionals across Latin America with global digital transformation initiatives.

As part of the Stefanini Group, we combine global reach with strong regional expertise to build agile, collaborative, and high-performing technology teams. Our professionals work closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver solutions that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, and business performance.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with strong CRM experience to support the analysis and improvement of enterprise customer management solutions.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, developers, and QA teams to understand business needs and translate them into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and functional documentation. You will contribute throughout the full delivery lifecycle, from discovery and backlog refinement to testing, implementation, and user adoption.

Experience with Salesforce is highly desirable. Candidates with strong experience in other enterprise CRM platforms, particularly within banking or financial services, may also be considered.


Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, document, and validate business and functional requirements.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, and requirements workshops.
  • Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities for improvement and automation.
  • Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, and functional specifications.
  • Ensure requirements are clear, complete, testable, and aligned with business objectives.
  • Collaborate with product owners, developers, QA professionals, and business stakeholders.
  • Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Clarify functional requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Support functional testing, system integration testing, and user acceptance testing.
  • Define test scenarios, validate delivered functionality, and support defect analysis and resolution.
  • Maintain documentation of requirements, decisions, dependencies, risks, and system behavior.
  • Support implementation, training, change management, and user adoption.
  • Identify opportunities to improve CRM processes, customer journeys, data quality, and user experience.


Requirements

  • Approximately 4 to 6 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Systems Analyst, or in a similar requirements-focused role.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms or CRM-related business processes.
  • Strong experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and validating business requirements.
  • Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, workflows, and functional documentation.
  • Experience facilitating meetings and requirements workshops with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies, such as Scrum.
  • Experience participating in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and iterative software delivery.
  • Experience collaborating with product owners, developers, QA professionals, and business stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting functional testing or user acceptance testing.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Advanced English, with the ability to participate in meetings and prepare professional documentation.


Nice to Have

  • Professional experience working with Salesforce.
  • Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.
  • Experience with CRM platforms in banking, fintech, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Knowledge of SQL, data validation, data modeling, or data analysis.
  • Experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar Agile collaboration tools.
  • Salesforce Business Analyst, Administrator, or related certification.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.


Why Join Us?

  • Work remotely as part of a collaborative and cross-functional technology environment.
  • Contribute to enterprise CRM and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Strengthen your experience in Business Analysis, Salesforce, and Agile delivery.

title: Case Assembly Drafter (Humanitarian Immigration)
description:
Who Are We?


Bueno Law is a trailblazing immigration law firm focused on empowering the Latin American LGBTQ+ community, survivors of domestic violence, victims of human trafficking, and other vulnerable individuals. We provide life-changing legal services to immigrants in the United States, and we’re looking for passionate, people-first individuals to join our remote team.


We specialize in:


  • Removal Defense (EOIR).
  • Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS).
  • Family‑Based Immigration.


Your Role as a


The Case Assembly Drafter plays a pivotal role in preparing, organizing, and finalizing all components of a client’s immigration case prior to attorney review. This position ensures every filing is complete, accurate, and supported by required evidence. Ideal candidates bring exceptional attention to detail, strong writing skills, and the ability to manage multiple case components in a fast‑paced, mission‑driven environment.


Key Responsibilities


Drafting & Documentation


  • Draft cover letters for all immigration case types.
  • Prepare TVAP referral emails and attorney affidavits for T‑Visa filings.
  • Draft 918B cover letters for U‑Visa certifications.
  • Summarize FBI background reports for T‑Visa cases.
  • Draft country conditions reports and SIJS‑specific filings.


Case Assembly


  • Assemble complete case filings in PDF format following firm standards.
  • Ensure all forms, declarations, evidence, and supporting documents are included and properly organized.
  • Upload supporting documents and applications for online‑filed cases.
  • Submit finalized case packets for attorney review using Airtable workflows.


Client & Evidence Management


  • Collect client signatures on all forms and declarations.
  • Gather and upload psychological evaluations.
  • For SIJS cases, collect signatures on GC‑211s.
  • Verify completeness and consistency of all required evidence.


Quality Control & Accuracy Checks


  • Conduct credibility checks to ensure dates, timelines, and narratives align across all documents.
  • Confirm all mandatory documents are present before submitting cases for review.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Submit formal requests to hold cases in abeyance when appropriate.
  • Coordinate with internal departments to obtain missing documents or follow‑up information.


Required Competencies & Skills


  • Bilingual or professional fluency in English.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to identify inconsistencies in client narratives and timelines.
  • Strong writing skills for drafting affidavits, cover letters, and formal requests.
  • Solid understanding of immigration case components and evidence requirements.
  • Excellent organizational and time‑management abilities.
  • Skilled in tracking signatures, evaluations, and supporting documentation.
  • Strong communication skills for client coordination and internal collaboration.
  • Comfort using Airtable, PDF tools, and online filing systems.


What We Offer:


  • Competitive pay above market rate.
  • Comprehensive training.
  • Paid vacation + sick leave.
  • Your birthday off.
  • U.S. paid holidays.
  • Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST.
  • A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Community Manager – RoboNeo Brazil
description:
Why We Need You:

RoboNeo ( is landing in Brazil, and we're building a creator community that can turn AI-powered imagination into reality. As our Community Manager, you'll be the one finding brilliant creators, getting them hooked on our tools, and fueling a movement that drives real user growth. This isn't managing an existing group — you'll build it from scratch in one of the most explosive markets for generative AI video. You'll work closely with product, marketing, and growth teams across different countries, and pick up skills that are only going to get more valuable. If you love AI, content, and the chaos of building something new, this is your spot.


What You'll Do:

· Scout and win over top AI creators across Brazil — identify talented voices, reach out, and get them excited about what RoboNeo can do;

· Own the relationship from first hello to long-term partnership — run interviews, onboard new creators, and keep the vibe strong with the people who matter most;

· Be the bridge between the community and our product — gather feedback, spot patterns, and help creators solve their real challenges with RoboNeo;

· Build and run training that actually helps — design educational flows, share pro tips, and level up the quality of content the community puts out;

· Keep a finger on the pulse with data — track community health every week, pull reports, and turn numbers into smarter moves that boost engagement.


Who You Are:

· You've got 1+ years of hands-on experience in community management, influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or something similar;

· Portuguese is your native language (or C1+) and you breathe Brazilian internet culture — you know where creators hang out, what formats fly, and what feels fake a mile away;

· You're genuinely curious about AI and content creation — you'd jump at the chance to geek out over new tools and become a product expert;

· You're a people person for real — you enjoy connecting with creators, reading what makes them tick, and building relationships that last beyond a DM;

· Numbers don't scare you — you're comfortable digging into metrics to see what's working, what's not, and turning those insights into action;

· You're a self-starter who builds things from zero — you don't wait for a manual, you figure it out and make it happen in a fast, scrappy environment.


Even Better If You...

· You've already worked with creator or UGC communities in video or photo content;

· You've played around with AI content generation tools and know what \"good\" looks like;

· English proficiency is a plus.

title: Gerente de Projetos – Transformação de Serviços de TI
description:
Atuar como responsável pela gestão e governança da iniciativa de transformação do ambiente de Managed Services, garantindo o planejamento, coordenação e acompanhamento das entregas previstas ao longo da execução. Será o principal ponto de gestão, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos, mitigação de riscos e alinhamento estratégico das diferentes frentes técnicas.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Elaborar, manter e controlar o cronograma, acompanhando todas as fases da transformação;
  • Coordenar a execução das entregas em conjunto com o Tech Lead, assegurando alinhamento entre as frentes de Observabilidade, Automação, IA, Redes e Capacity Planning;
  • Identificar, monitorar e mitigar riscos, dependências e impedimentos que possam impactar prazo, escopo, qualidade ou custo do projeto;
  • Conduzir cerimônias de acompanhamento do projeto, reuniões de status, checkpoints executivos e fóruns de governança;
  • Atuar como principal interface de gestão junto ao cliente para acompanhamento de marcos, indicadores, mudanças de escopo e tomada de decisões;
  • Consolidar indicadores de progresso, riscos, pendências e roadmap executivo, produzindo reportes periódicos para o Tech Lead e para a diretoria;
  • Garantir a adequada gestão das mudanças (change management), priorização das demandas e acompanhamento das ações definidas durante a execução;
  • Apoiar a governança contratual da iniciativa, acompanhando entregas previstas, marcos de aceite e aderência ao planejamento estabelecido.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência consolidada na gestão de projetos de tecnologia;
  • Vivência em projetos envolvendo infraestrutura de TI, automação, observabilidade, cloud, operações de TI ou Inteligência Artificial;
  • Conhecimento sólido em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de gerenciamento de projetos (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK e/ou híbrido);
  • Experiência em gestão de cronograma, riscos, dependências, stakeholders e mudanças de escopo.


Informações adicionais

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto

Modelo de contratação: PJ


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente colaborativo e multicultural;
  • Oportunidade de aprendizado prático em processos financeiros corporativos;
  • Contato com profissionais experientes e diferentes áreas do negócio;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional em uma das líderes globais em tecnologia.


🚀 Se você busca uma oportunidade para desenvolver sua carreira em Finanças e deseja aprender na prática em um ambiente inovador, inscreva-se e venha fazer parte do nosso time!


♿ Na T-Systems, valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos na construção de um ambiente acolhedor, onde o crescimento e a valorização profissional acontecem de forma igualitária e responsável. Somos comprometidos com a inclusão e convidamos também pessoas com deficiência (PCD) a se candidatarem. Venha fazer parte do nosso time magenta!

title: Licensing Operations, & Financial Resolution Specialist
description:
Location: Brazil (100% Remote or Hybrid for Serra Gaúcha or São Paulo residents)

Compensation Currency: Brazilian Real (BRL)

Contract: Permanent Full Time (CLT) - 42h/week


About Us

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialized in technology.


Role Purpose

This role ensures that customers receive the products, services, licences, and entitlements they have purchased — accurately and with minimal customer effort. The specialist resolves customer enquiries raised via Zendesk that relate to invoices, contracts in Salesforce, and related systems, acting as the operational owner for entitlement, billing, and data integrity matters within standard service levels.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce and NetSuite (the team's go-forward systems); willingness and ability to learn additional legacy systems as needed
  • Prior experience with a ticketing tool such as Zendesk is a plus but not required
  • High level of English, written and spoken — the role requires clear communication with global, internal stakeholders
  • Strong written communication skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable working across multiple, sometimes unfamiliar, IT systems
  • Able to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
  • Strong team player who collaborates across Sales, Finance, Operations, and Support

Core Responsibilities Entitlement & Licensing Management

  • Accurately assign licences and service entitlements and rapidly activate new purchases
  • Manage upgrades, downgrades, renewals, and licensee transfers/reassignments
  • Monitor licence allocation and usage; identify under- or over-utilised licences
  • Verify customers have access to all products and services purchased; audit and reconcile entitlements
  • Resolve entitlement discrepancies and prevent access interruptions
  • Interpret contractual entitlement rights and validate product, support, and service eligibility
  • Ensure alignment between contracts, orders, invoices, and entitlement systems, including for complex enterprise agreements

Billing & Invoice Support

  • Own customer billing enquiries end-to-end via Zendesk tickets, from first response through resolution
  • Investigate disputed charges and resolve invoice discrepancies, explaining charges, credits, and taxes clearly
  • Raise credit note requests and provide first-level approval of credit notes raised by other areas
  • Validate contract pricing and entitlements against billing records
  • Handle invoice, statement, and contract copy requests

Data Quality & Master Data Management

  • Maintain the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of customer, billing, and entitlement records
  • Identify and resolve data discrepancies and remove duplicate records
  • Validate data against source systems (Salesforce, NetSuite, and other platforms) and contractual agreements
  • Coordinate master data updates across CRM, billing, licensing, and support platforms
  • Process changes in billing frequency, currency, and historical contract corrections

Reconciliation, Change & Escalation Management

  • Reconcile data between systems and investigate root causes of mismatches
  • Support customer mergers, acquisitions, and organisational/account hierarchy changes
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Technical Support on business-critical issues
  • Own priority investigation and escalation of entitlement and data issues within defined SLAs

Reporting

  • Contribute to entitlement summaries, licence position, and renewal/expiry reporting (with the BI team)
  • Support data quality scorecards, customer data health assessments, and root-cause reporting

Service Expectations

  • Proactive: Monitor upcoming expirations and data anomalies; flag gaps before they affect the customer
  • Accurate: Get entitlement and data changes right first time, with full traceability
  • Responsive: Provide timely, reliable resolution within standard SLAs
  • Transparent: Give clear visibility into issue status, ownership, and resolution

title: Head of Business & Operations (Brazil Resident)
description:
About the company

We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet.


Why this role

We are entering the Brazilian market as a Banco Central do Brasil-authorised Virtual Asset Service Provider, and you would be our first Business & Operations Officer on the ground. Under BCB Resolution 520/2025, VASPs are required to designate a statutory director responsible for conducting the institution's business and ensuring alignment with its commercial and strategic objectives — this is that seat. In your first year, you will have established the operational foundation of Gate's Brazil entity, built the company's commercial presence in the market, and ensured our business activities run in full alignment with the BCB's regulatory expectations.


What you'll do

  • Hold statutory director responsibility for business conduct and operations at a BCB-authorised VASP, with personal accountability for acting in good faith and in the company's best interest
  • Oversee and conduct the institution's day-to-day business activities, ensuring alignment with Gate's commercial strategy and operational objectives in Brazil
  • Act as the primary operational interface between Gate's Brazil entity and its regional and global leadership, translating strategic direction into local execution
  • Maintain personal fitness and propriety; disclose, without prompting, anything that touches your fitness, propriety, or potential conflicts — to the company and to the BCB
  • Drive the VASP authorisation process forward on the business and operations workstream, including declarations and documentation the BCB requests on its own timeline
  • Discharge any additional duties prescribed by applicable Brazilian laws, regulations, or by the company


What you'll bring

Must-have

  • Brazilian permanent residency or citizenship , with the ability to maintain ordinary residency in Brazil for as long as the role requires
  • You hold no competing statutory director or officer seat at another regulated entity in Brazil
  • A predominantly commercial and operational profile — you have led or co-led a business unit, market expansion, or operational function, not just supported one
  • Prior experience at a BCB-regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto/VASP — familiarity with how regulated entities operate in Brazil is essential
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, written and spoken
  • Willing to undergo a full BCB fit-and-proper review and disclose what it requires


Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience in the crypto or digital asset industry
  • Direct prior engagement with BCB on regulatory filings, inspections, or authorisation processes
  • Academic background or postgraduate training in business, finance, economics, or law

title: Direct Response Ads | Video Editor
description:
About Hydroh:


We’re one of the fastest-growing Shopify-based DTC brands in the world at the forefront of all things hydrogen water.


Our product line includes hydrogen water bottles, supplements, and accessories all designed to help people recover faster, reduce inflammation, and feel their best.


We’re looking for a Performance Video Editor who deeply understands how to cut direct response ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is NOT a branding video role we’re talking scroll-stopping hooks, retention-driven pacing, and revenue-first editing.


Compensation & Perks:

  • Base Salary + Performance Bonus (Depending on experience and skillset)
  • Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)
  • Fully Remote
  • Resources, trainings, and courses covered we invest in our people.


What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years experience editing direct response video ads for DTC brands
  • Portfolio of paid ads you've edited (Meta, TikTok, YT Shorts — performance-focused)
  • Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or equivalent
  • Strong understanding of performance editing — you know what makes a video convert
  • Experience editing UGC-style content, influencer videos, and testimonial formats
  • Ability to follow creative briefs and storyboards, but also contribute your own ideas
  • Comfortable with iterating quickly based on feedback and performance data
  • Clear communicator and proactive with timelines


Bonus Points:

  • Experience working with health & wellness or skincare brands
  • Familiarity with tools like Frame.io, Slack, and Notion
  • Understanding of hooks, angles, and stages of awareness
  • Editing for long-form VSLs


What you'll be doing:

  • Edit short-form performance videos (15–90 seconds) optimized for Meta and TikTok
  • Implement scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced edits, dynamic subtitles, and retention overlays
  • Work closely with our Creative Strategist and UGC Project Manager to execute on weekly ad briefs
  • Repurpose UGC content, testimonials, and influencer clips into winning ad angles
  • Apply performance data to iterate and improve ad creatives week over week
  • Deliver assets fast we move quickly and expect tight turnaround when needed



We’re looking to hire immediately — so if you’re an editor who gets performance, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description:
Video Editor

Full-time – Remote


MenuFit is the #1 app for eating out healthy. Point it at any restaurant menu and it tells you exactly what to order to hit your macros and your goal — calories, protein, the whole breakdown — even for places that never published nutrition data.


We're #7 in Health & Fitness in the US App Store, rated 4.8 stars across 53,000+ reviews , with 1.5M+ users and 22.3M+ restaurant locations covered.


Now, we're looking for a Video Editor to join our team!


You'll be responsible for editing video ads for Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, turning raw footage, scripts, and creative direction into engaging, high-performing content .


You'll work closely with our paid acquisition lead to adapt content for different platforms, test variations, and bring ad concepts to life. Your edits will play a key role in driving trials, conversions, and brand growth.


🚀 What You'll Do
  • Work closely with our Founder and Head of Paid Acquisition to bring our paid social ads to life across Instagram, TikTok and Facebook.
  • Edit short-form video ads using raw footage, voiceovers, and creator content, with a strong focus on clarity, pacing, and engagement.
  • Adapt content for different platforms and audiences, ensuring each video feels native to the channel.
  • Collaborate with creators, copywriters, and performance marketers to test multiple versions and hooks.
  • Use performance data and trends to iterate quickly — every creative here is judged on cost per trial and ROAS, and you'll see those numbers.
  • Help shape the look and feel of our ad creative, maintaining consistency with our brand tone and aesthetic.


What You Bring
  • You're a highly creative and detail-oriented video editor with a portfolio of short-form ad content that performs.
  • You have a strong understanding of performance marketing and how to edit for attention, emotion, and conversion.
  • You've created ads for Instagram and TikTok that actually convert.
  • You're comfortable working with raw creator content , motion graphics, text overlays, voiceovers, and you know how to use storytelling and experiment with new creative formats to keep content fresh, engaging, and high-performing.
  • You're collaborative, fast, and resourceful , with the ability to juggle multiple variations and work on tight deadlines.


🤝 Details
  • Full-time role
  • Location: Remote
  • $1200 - $1500 USD per month


Perks
  • Work directly with the Founder, the Head of Paid Acquisition, and a small, hungry team solving a real-world problem.
  • A product with real retention, real revenue, and real impact.
  • Creative that ships fast and gets tested against real spend — you'll know within days whether an edit worked.


Ready to apply?

To apply for this role, please put in your application in this Google Form and we will get back to you. We look forward to hearing from you.
